_1_password: The admin password is NOT written here. It is encrypted (scrypt) the first time the server starts. Default password is 1234 - change it from the Admin menu on the page.
_2_recoveryEmail: Where the forgot-password code (OTP) is sent.
_3_mail: mail.mode picks HOW the code is sent. Use one of: console | gmail | smtp
_4_console: console = no email at all. The code is printed in the black server window and saved in otp.log. Good for testing.
_5_gmail: gmail = Gmail or Google Workspace. Put your address in mail.gmail.user and a 16-character App Password in mail.gmail.appPassword (Google Account > Security > 2-Step Verification > App passwords). Your normal Gmail password will NOT work.
_6_smtp: smtp = your own company mail server. Fill in host, port, secure, user, password. Port 587 = secure false (STARTTLS). Port 465 = secure true.
